route-01/step-01: 에틸 4-니트로벤조에이트에서 벤조카인으로; 방향족 니트로기(–NO₂)가 아미노기(–NH₂)로 바뀌고 에틸 에스터는 유지됨
route-02/step-01: 에틸 4-아세트아미도벤조에이트에서 벤조카인으로; N-아세틸기가 제거되어 아미노기가 드러나며 에틸 에스터는 유지됨

limitations.note: Parrot conditions are not inputs to the yield model. Predicted yields are not experimentally validated.
Target-specific accuracy and domain membership are not assessed; normalization correctness is not accuracy validation.
Temperature, time and equivalents are not supplied by the selected condition checkpoint.
Stock membership and template scores do not prove practical feasibility. Search excludes target from stock; agents/byproducts can be omitted.

harness_comparison.limit: one case per harness; no general performance ranking

mopac.limit: isolated molecular geometries/charges/formation heats; not reaction barrier, rate, success, or yield

epi_suite.limit: MP/BP estimates and database records distinguished; unsupported/no-match values remain missing; neat-material properties do not settle mixture state

discovery_studio.limit: isolated structures only; no reactant pair or external attack trajectory; no barrier/rate/success/yield inference

report_plan.selection_rule: Initial score-order presentation shortlist; not a claim of chemical feasibility. Review chemistry before final authoring.

normalization.training_domain: USPTO gram-scale random split; target-specific applicability not assessed
normalization.normalization_note: Recovered from original gram random_split=train rows using the authors' preprocessing and pandas sample standard deviation. Not global-dataset substitute statistics.
